properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Norman has issued a Flood Warning
for the following rivers in Oklahoma...

Canadian River near Bridgeport affecting Blaine, Canadian, Grady
and Caddo Counties.

For the Upper Canadian River...including Taloga, Bridgeport, Mustang,
Norman, Purcell, Calvin...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Canadian River near Bridgeport.

* WHEN...Until this evening.

* IMPACTS...At 14.0 feet, Flooding affects croplands... pastures...
and oil wells near the river. Low-lying bottomlands near the river
may be cut off from easy access by high water in side channels.
Sand dredging operations are affected. Upstream points in southern
Blaine County experience flooding before the areas near Bridgeport
in northern Caddo County. Downstream points in southwestern
Canadian County are affected hours later.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 5:45 AM CDT Wednesday the stage was 13.1 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 14.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage this
morning to a crest of 14.5 feet this afternoon. It will then fall
below flood stage late this afternoon.
- Flood stage is 14.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 14.5
feet on 03/17/1998.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

rising river levels.
